messages:
maria: heads up — we've got a spike of GPU evictions and P2P being reported disabled across us-west-2 Ampere nodes after last night's kernel rollout. metric: pod_gpu_alloc_failures +420% in 20m. logs show NCCL transport errors and intermittent BAR1 allocation timeouts.
engops-bot: alert: GPU_POOL_USW2_A100 - 202 -> p2p_disabled_count=128, evictions=46, avg_alloc_latency_ms=3100 :warning:
simon: which kernel/drivers did we push? is this the 6.0.x canary?
maria: yes — kernel 6.0.3 + driver 535 pushed to ampere pool at 02:10 UTC. fallback nodes (older kernel+525) look healthy.
lee: we're seeing this in the node logs: 
```
[ 1234.567890] nvidia-modeset: BAR1 window size reduced from 256M to 64M on GPU 0
[ 1234.568000] nvidia: p2p init failed: insufficient BAR1
[ 1234.568100] nv_peer_mem: failed to map peer BAR1 region
```
ashok: that BAR1 shrinkage pattern matches PCIe resource allocation changes in 6.0 kernel rework. Might be new PCIe link resource enumeration path.
dalia: immediate mitigation: start cordoning affected us-west-2 Ampere nodes and drain critical pods to the dedicated pool (us-east-1) to stop noisy evictions. I can script the cordon+drain. :hammer_and_wrench:
lee: we should also toggle the driver-side p2p safety flag to avoid triggering NCCL fallback storms. set NV_P2P_ENABLE=0 for inference workloads that tolerate slightly higher latency.
simon: agree. Plan: (1) canary rollback of kernel 6.0.3 -> 5.15.x on 4 nodes, (2) enable NV_P2P_ENABLE=0 for realtime routes, (3) monitor allocation latency and NCCL errors for 1h, (4) if green, schedule rolling rollback across pool.
maria: cost note — draining to other regions will cause a bump in reserve/spot churn. Estimating ~10% extra on-demand spend for 48h if we move ~60% of traffic. Flagging finance.
ashok: low-risk alternative: test pci_acs_override kernel param on canary to see if BAR1 mapping improves without full rollback: add pci_acs_override=downstream to grub and reboot one canary. risky but faster.
dalia: created INC-9321 and assigned to eng-infra (owner: simon). added logs and node list.
simon: executing canary rollback now on node amp-a100-uw2-23. I'll post results.
maria: thanks — also please collect `lspci -vvv | grep -A3 "Region 0"` and `nvidia-smi topo -m` before/after so we can compare BAR1/peer topology.
lee: quick snippet to collect: 
```
lspci -s 0000:3b:00.0 -vvv | egrep "Region|BAR" -A2
nvidia-smi topo -m
cat /sys/module/nvidia/parameters/PeerToPeer
```
simon: canary rollback complete. node back up on 5.15.101 + driver 525. preliminary metrics: p2p_disabled_count -> 0, alloc_latency_ms -> 120 ms, NCCL errors cleared.
maria: great. Stand by for full pool rollback schedule. If anyone objects to full rollback we need mitigation runway (pci_acs override test + p2p-disable flag) and a cost estimate for a cross-region failover.
dalia: noted — will add mitigation steps to INC-9321 runbook and ping sales/product for customer impact comms. :white_check_mark:
